nodes.description: Ownable.owner address that controls ownership; set from msg.sender in constructor.
Public total token supply, initialized to initialSupply and reduced by burn().
mapping(address => uint256) token balances mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowance ledger mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Constant 500000000 * 10**18 computed with unchecked multiplication.
Constant token name '7 Stars'.
Constant token symbol 'STAR'.
Constant token decimals = 18.
SafeMath.mul: a*b with assert(c/a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath.div: unchecked a/b division, reverts on b==0.
SafeMath.sub: assert(b <= a) then a-b, guards underflow.
SafeMath.add: assert(c >= a) overflow guard.
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender without zero-address check.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before execution of the guarded function.
onlyOwner function that reassigns owner to newOwner after zero-address check.
View returning balances[_owner].
ERC20 transfer: subtracts _value from balances[msg.sender] and adds to balances[_to].
ERC20 transferFrom: reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] into _allowance and moves balances.
ERC20 approve: overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _value (classic race window).
View returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Adds _addedValue to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using SafeMath.add.
Reduces allowed[msg.sender][_spender], zeroing it when _subtractedValue > oldValue.
Burns _value from msg.sender balance and reduces totalSupply.
STAR constructor: mints initialSupply to msg.sender and sets totalSupply.
msg.sender used as the initial owner in the Ownable constructor.
msg.sender used as the debited account in transfer().
msg.sender used as spender key when reading/updating allowed[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender used as the owner key when writing allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender used as the burner whose balance and totalSupply are reduced.
Privileged state write owner = msg.sender executed with no validation of the caller.
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) balance mutation in transfer.
Allowance read and decrement allowed[_from][msg.sender] = _allowance.sub(_value) in transferFrom.
Direct overwrite of allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in approve enabling allowance race.
totalSupply = totalSupply.sub(_value) supply mutation in burn.
Unchecked multiplication 500000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals)) used for initialSupply.
Parameter _to of transfer(); destination address.
Parameter _value of transfer(); amount debited/credited.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(); source address whose allowance/balance is used.
Parameter _spender of approve(); allowance grantee.
Parameter _value of approve(); allowance amount written.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership(); new privileged address.
Parameter _value of burn(); amount destroyed.
Local burner = msg.sender inside burn().
Local oldValue caching allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in decreaseApproval.
Local _allowance caching allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor stores msg.sender directly into the privileged owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner, so caller identity controls privileged execution.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged owner state variable to newOwner.
msg.sender supplies the account key used in balances[msg.sender].sub(_value).
transfer executes the balance subtraction on balances[msg.sender].
Result of balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) is written back into the balances mapping.
msg.sender is the spender key used to read and decrement the allowance in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs the allowance read and decrement.
allowance decrement is stored into allowed[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is the owner key overwritten in allowed[msg.sender][_spender] by approve.
approve directly overwrites the allowance slot without a zero-first guard.
approve writes _value into the allowed mapping.
msg.sender derived burner account drives the totalSupply subtraction in burn.
burn executes totalSupply = totalSupply.sub(_value).
burn result is stored into the totalSupply state variable.
burn mutates balances[burner] via balances[burner].sub(_value).
SafeMath.mul is the overflow-guarded multiplication used for supply arithmetic.
STAR constructor computes initialSupply with unchecked multiplication and 10**decimals.
Multiplication result is assigned to the initialSupply constant.
Constructor sets totalSupply = initialSupply.
Constructor mints the entire supply to balances[msg.sender].
_to addresses the credited balance in transfer.
_value is the amount passed to SafeMath.sub/add in transfer.
_from keys both balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
_spender keys the allowance slot written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner address.
_value is the burned amount subtracted from balance and totalSupply.
Local burner caches msg.sender and keys balances[burner] in burn.
Local oldValue caches the allowance compared against _subtractedValue.
Local _allowance caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] before subtraction.
transfer credits balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value).
transferFrom debits balances[_from] and credits balances[_to].
increaseApproval adds to and stores the allowance mapping.
decreaseApproval writes the reduced or zeroed allowance.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient argument only used to index balances inside transfer.
_value is the arithmetic operand fed into balances[msg.sender].sub(_value).
_from is a transient key used for balances and allowed lookups in transferFrom.
_spender is the transient key of the allowance slot overwritten by approve.
_value is the allowance value written by the approve overwrite.
newOwner is only used to reassign the owner state variable within transferOwnership.
_value is the transient burn amount consumed by burn.
Local burner is just a cached copy of msg.sender used in the burn state updates.
oldValue is a temporary cache of the allowance read inside decreaseApproval.
_allowance is a temporary cache of allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
